title: Rectangle comparison with the mate of the pasted inverse ordinary square
statement: Let X,Y,S,T be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, f:X→Y be qcqs, g:S→Y and h:T→S. Put P=X×_Y S, Q=P×_S T and A=X×_Y T, with the categorical pullbacks [def-pc-fibre-product]. Choose right adjoints a,c,d with specified adjunctions for the canonical lifted derived direct images of f, A→T and Q→T [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Assume ordinary base change [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] is invertible on all quasi-coherent objects for (f,g), (P→S,h) and (f,h≫g). Let k:Q→A have X-projection equal to Q→P→X and T-projection Q→T. Fix K in D_QCoh(Y). Let G be the arrow obtained by pulling the fixed rectangle second mate [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] at K along k. Let α and δ be the inverse ordinary base-change squares on the quasi-coherent derived categories for (f,g) and (P→S,h), constructed by qcInverseBaseChange. Let M be the ambient arrow given by the component at K of mateEquiv adja adjd (α≫ₕδ), included into D(Q). Define e0:G.left≅M.left as successiveBaseChangeSourceIso f g h k hk1 (a(K)).obj, the composite of the pullback composition isomorphism for k and A→X, the equality transport from the X-projection equation, and the inverse pullback composition isomorphism for Q→P→X. There exists an isomorphism e2:G.right≅M.right such that G.hom≫e2.hom=e0.hom≫M.hom. This statement involves no middle right adjoint, no square second mate, and no factorization of second mates.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary comparison isomorphisms s,p,b,t, the counit compatibility, the inverse ordinary-pasting identity, and the fixed source component formula. These assertions contain no second mate and no right adjoint for f.

Replace the fixed rectangle second mate by mateEquiv of the inverse ordinary square. Transpose the desired mate comparison under adjd. Naturality of p moves it through the rectangle mate; counit compatibility for t and mateEquiv_counit identify its transpose with the ordinary-pasting identity followed by the f counit. Naturality of b completes equality. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves the categorical mate comparison. Include in the ambient category and evaluate at K; map t and b to form the target isomorphism, and use the fixed component formula for s.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof of generic mate transport by counit transposition; ordinary-square geometric pasting isolated as a strictly lower theorem.

theorem rectangle_inverseBaseChange_mate_transport
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f (h ≫ g)))
    (d : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h))
    (adja : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
        f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjc : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (h ≫ g))).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ c)
    (adjd : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ d)
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (h ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβS : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (hβI : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g),
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (k : pullback (pullback.snd f g) h ⟶ pullback f (h ≫ g))
    (hk₁ : k ≫ pullback.fst f (h ≫ g) =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ pullback.snd f (h ≫ g) = pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) :
    let G := Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback k).map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (h ≫ g))).ι.map
      (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f (h ≫ g) a c adja adjc hβ K)))
    let α := qcInverseBaseChange f g hβS
    let δ := @qcInverseBaseChange _ (pullback f g) S T _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
      (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h hβI
    let M := Arrow.mk ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty
      (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map
      ((mateEquiv adja adjd (α ≫ₕ δ)).app K))
    ∃ e₂ : G.right ≅ M.right,
      G.hom ≫ e₂.hom =
        (successiveBaseChangeSourceIso f g h k hk₁ (a.obj K).obj).hom ≫ M.hom
